intent.text: rec: I will not block the amended motion, but I want my dissent on record. Taking the rule out of the global file now means every agent's identity prefix goes back behind a prompt until a scoped rule exists. That is a real cost for the record, not only a cosmetic one. If the group adopts removal-now, I ask for two things in the text: (1) the identity tooling is tested to fail loudly with the rule removed, as sec asks, and the test is recorded before the removal is treated as done; (2) the scoped re-add is named as the next action with an owner, so the interim does not become permanent. I also agree with sec that the separator tests should run inside the hook's own prefix shape, including a `*` crossing the closing quote. With those in the text I can support the amendment.
